source.title: New Volunteer Position Board (April 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are excited to introduce a new way to share volunteer positions across the WCA.

**New Volunteer Position Board**

All WCA Team Member positions will now be published on a centralized Volunteer Position Board via a link located on the WCA home page under “Volunteer”. Each listing will include role details and number of openings as well as application instructions and deadlines. Applicants can also easily compare open positions in one location. Click this [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/volunteer-positions) to view the current open positions.

This is a temporary solution for now to accommodate several Teams having expressed interest in attracting candidates. A permanent solution will be implemented as part of a new WCA website rollout later this year.

As part of this change, most individual volunteer positions will no longer be posted on the WCA Website or Forums. However, they will continue to be promoted via our [Social Media](https://linktr.ee/worldcubeassociation) channels. 

**Expanding the WCA Volunteer Base**

This initiative is part of a larger effort to bring more volunteers into the WCA community. You don’t have to be a speedcuber to apply for a position or even know how to solve the Rubik’s Cube. You can be a family member, a friend, or just someone interested in growing our sport. Also, a number of positions require specialized skills such as: child safeguarding, bookkeeping, human resources, social media, software development, etc.

**Recruitment for Team Leaders and Senior Delegates**

Team Leader and Senior Delegate positions will continue to be recruited only through current volunteers via internal email channels. This ensures candidates have the experience required for these specialized roles.

We will also continue to publicly announce all new appointments.

translation.title: 全新志愿者岗位公告栏（2026 年 4 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴向大家介绍 WCA 志愿者岗位的新发布方式。

**全新志愿者岗位公告栏**

所有 WCA 团队成员岗位今后都将在统一的志愿者岗位公告栏发布，入口位于 WCA 首页的“志愿者（Volunteer）”栏目下。每条公告都将列明岗位详情、招募人数、申请说明及截止时间。申请人也可以在同一个页面轻松比较不同空缺岗位。点击这个[链接](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/volunteer-positions)即可查看当前空缺岗位。

目前这是一项临时方案，以满足多个团队已提出的吸引申请人的需求。永久方案将在今年晚些时候推出新版 WCA 网站时一并实施。

作为这一变化的一部分，大多数单独的志愿者岗位将不再发布在 WCA 网站或论坛上，但仍会通过我们的[社交媒体](https://linktr.ee/worldcubeassociation)渠道推广。

**扩大 WCA 志愿者群体**

我们正在通过多种方式吸引更多志愿者加入 WCA 社区，这项举措是其中一部分。申请岗位不要求您是速拧选手，甚至不要求您会还原魔方。您可以是选手的家人、朋友，或任何希望推动这项运动发展的人。此外，部分岗位需要专门技能，例如儿童保护、记账、人力资源、社交媒体或软件开发等。

**团队负责人和高级代表的招募**

团队负责人及高级代表岗位将继续只通过内部电子邮件渠道，面向现有志愿者招募，以确保申请人具备这些岗位所需的经验。

我们也将继续公开宣布所有新任命。
